# Native assignment semantics through cached incoming and assimilation

Published base: 45a5eca6c1fdcb924a90ddb16ab416752c4a2208.
Imported main: 6c080537a1a758cd4c4d9b6583c3470024b96850.
Assimilation and prefix commit: 1801f54a5c601ce944f7ac86f02751eeccd87766.
Cached incoming and dispatch commit: a0ea22b12f26bf63ba3577a7e2c26989d07017c6.
The full formalization goal stays ACTIVE and incomplete. Keep the optimized
interned core. Preserve earlier proofs, counterexamples, repairs and marked
drafts. Earlier constructor and equality work remain secondary targets.
The preceding checkpoint is `lean/notes-current-pruning-incoming-language.md`.

## Strongest claims and boundaries

H6 remains SourceCurrentColdFiniteWarmCalls.constructed_node_calls. Under
formal Formula and Entailment semantics, covered closed construction and
valid constraint-allocation history derive enough fuel and one mathematical
width for any chosen finite number of modeled node-processing rounds and
any budget. Empty inherited payload gives exact finite-tree language at the
final available node. Its source remains byte-identical at SHA256
`e4665b0bb522ec88f1925fe6bc360b76e9e4bdfbe6192210ac708a3097a20cc5`.

SourcePruningEnumerationRecursive.run_finite_complete_resources still gives
original resource bounds for every chosen finite recursive capacity. The
actual complete or explicit stopped result stays stable at all larger work
fuels. Each output keeps its own cache, native endpoint and full memos.
Resource bounds do not prove whole-enumerator language or capacity adequacy.

The new cached incoming theorem is
SourcePruningEnumerationIncomingCacheAdapter.complete_semantics.
It keeps the exact original complete inputs and entire receipt. The producer
runs once. Its actual read witness and original root derive the old stored
slot. The replacement receipt and successful lookup preservation derive its
exact language at the returned native heap. The exact write and frame then
derive complete assignment meaning of after.core. Its returned raw list
accepts exactly assignments satisfying before.core, incoming node meaning
and all incoming suspended constraints. Empty has a logical cached candidate
but no satisfying returned branch. No second incoming producer is used.

SourcePruningEnumerationAssimilationLanguage.assimilated_semantics covers
the actual two-slot update without Graph.IntersectionCorrect. It requires
exact stored pending slots and a local merged-domain relation. Source and
target already share a forest class. Every satisfying assignment therefore
gives them equal terms. Each implication derives equality from its own
endpoint's forest satisfaction. The target receives both optional domains
and the full sourceScs++targetScs list. The source becomes eliminated. No
old restriction is dropped. No satisfying final assignment is an input.

SourcePruningEnumerationTerminalPrefix.run_complete_semantics keeps the
entire original prefix result and calls its producer once. Old roots are
idempotent. Each recorded source and the winner therefore maps to the
winner in the actual returned mergedRoots map. The returned finite paths
prove SameClass after.representatives source winner for each recorded source.
The actual pre-scan, full union loop and winner lookup also give
Satisfies(after) iff Satisfies(before) AND every listed rest equation
assignment(first.var)=assignment(sc.var). The theorem retains these added
equalities. The union step does not preserve assignments unconditionally.

SourcePruningEnumerationDispatch.dispatch_complete_semantics keeps the
entire old dispatcher result and calls that producer once. It appends a
conditional semantic statement for arbitrary ambient environments, residual
guard meanings and assignments. WHEN the original forest equates source and
target, successful returned rows accept exactly the original assignments.
The condition is in the new semantic clause. It is not a new input to the
old execution theorem. TerminalPrefix now derives it at its actual endpoint.
The unchanged fold forest retains it for later recorded sources.

SourcePruningEnumerationDispatch.observed_semantics transfers the canonical
semantic packet to ANY actual successful dispatcher observation at admitted
original inputs. DispatchUnique.ok_unique identifies its action, caller and
query memos even at different bounds. Post, used pending-handle realization
and assignment equivalence then refer to the actual reached caller. The
input is an execution equation. No desired semantic fact is an input.

No-op routes retain the original core and caller. Missing optional domains
use the actual orElse receipt. The both-present route uses the returned
native conjunction-language receipt and successful old lookup preservation.
Merged handle zero denotes Empty. The literal target write therefore has
no satisfying assignment when the actual action returns []. Nonempty actions
return the same singleton logical state already supplied by the dispatcher.
Native effects remain at the actual returned endpoint on both routes.

These are local native assignment theorems. Whole-enumerator soundness and
completeness, whole typing/pruning language, withoutRedundantEdges, unbounded
termination, recursive-capacity adequacy, convergence, concrete solver and
Haskell correspondence, physical containers, machine integers, extraction,
arbitrary lazy demand and practical time or memory bounds remain open.

## Next actual composition

Prove assignment meaning of SourcePruningEnumerationFold.run_complete for
the entire ordered source list and the first Empty rejection. It must use
each actual reached caller and heap. The old completion result retains final
Post, shape, forest and first-rejection receipts. It does not export all
intermediate dispatcher receipts. Do not infer missing assignment transport
from those shape or resource invariants. Do not assume future successful
calls, final Satisfies or a desired language relation as admission.

Use induction over actual native fold execution. Use observed_semantics
to identify an actual head with its semantic packet. Obtain each head's semantic
producer and retain its complete receipt. Pay a common sufficient bound for
the head and suffix. Native growth preserves the pending handles used by
that prefix's state. Later siblings receive its actual caller and full memos.
The representative forest stays exact, so every recorded source keeps the
winner's class. A rejected head makes the admitted complete-assignment set
empty. A surviving head passes exact assignment equivalence to the suffix.
If retaining the old full fold receipt through a new wrapper, identify old
and new actual outcomes at a common larger bound; do not identify unrelated
existential witnesses by their names.

Then compose the actual terminal prefix, full fold and incoming adapter.
The prefix adds requested union equations; terminal suspended constraints
must justify them where the later language contract requires preservation.
Lift backward assignment semantics to each recursive output at its own cache
and native heap. Current Packet has resource and representation invariants,
not an assignment-preservation invariant. Selector membership and length
still allow edgesOf=[]. Stop can emit partial metadata. Selected terminal
or nonordinary fallback remains unsupported. Stratified alone lacks the
neutral-pending premise needed for complete assignments. State coverage,
supported semantic domain, output and progress conditions before claiming
whole-enumerator language or recursive-capacity adequacy.
